primary_test.ci_scope: Primary query intervals condition on the observed paired training seeds. Four seeds do not establish universal training-seed robustness.
primary_test.multiplicity: One frozen business-macro primary comparison; domain intervals are pointwise, and every domain must pass the noninferiority gate.
primary_test.cost_boundary: Quality advantage alone does not establish cost or throughput advantage.

boundary: The post-hoc DEV router is tested once on two disjoint query splits under four paired training seeds. Query intervals condition on those observed seeds; no universal seed or cost claim is made.
